It had not inspected the 25 actual envelopes. The subsequent preflight counterexample disproved that assumption; the earlier no-blocking-finding status was insufficient to establish executable preflight compatibility.
previousReview.disposition: The earlier receipt and both failed attempts remain unchanged. This receipt records the correction and limitation; it does not rewrite historical outcomes.

checks.name: contract_scope_and_historical_failure_unchanged
